_about: Local housing authorities per region (ONS ward-to-LAD-to-region lookup, May 2026) and their selective (Housing Act 2004 Part 3) and additional HMO (Part 2) licensing schemes, each read on the council's own website at the source URL on the date in 'checked'. 'until' is given only where the council's own document states it. 'none found': no scheme found on the council website (not published as a fact). 'not verified': the council website could not be read, so nothing is published. Regenerate pages with python3 tools/gen_guides.py.
